secrets.name: SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Signing key for JWT access tokens (any long random string).

secrets.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Password of the bootstrap administrator account (username: admin).

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Stripe secret key (sk_live_/sk_test_) from https://dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys — needed for real card top-ups.

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Optional. Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_...) from Dashboard → Developers → Webhooks — required before any order is credited.

secrets.name: TURN_URL
secrets.description: Optional. TURN server URL (turn:host:3478) for voice between different mobile networks; a STUN-only service works on the same network.

secrets.name: SMTP_HOST
secrets.description: Optional. SMTP host used to email verification and reset codes; without it the codes stay in the API log.

secrets.name: SMTP_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Optional. SMTP password or app password.
